kernel.governing_law: An obstruction between jaws must be bitten through; penetration is achieved through enforced severance; clarity (fire) energizing force (thunder) constitutes legitimate violence — the state's power to punish is modeled on the storm's self-evidence.
kernel.mutated_relation: The obstruction is what allows the jaw to know itself as jaw — severance is not penetration but the confession that the interval could not be closed; the storm does not clarify the law but reveals that law requires an opacity it cannot burn away.
kernel.beats:
100101 -> 011010
噬嗑 -> 间识 (interval-knowing)
火雷 -> 暗隙 (dark-gap)
离上震下 -> 坎下巽上 (the inversion: abyss below, permeation above)
亨 -> 阻 (halting — the condition for claiming penetration is the persistence of what resists)
利用狱 -> 困于闭 (caught-in-enclosure — the condition for advantageous imprisonment is the confessor's own confinement within the act of confining)
象曰 -> 形默 (the shape is silent — the condition for the Image speaking is the priority of what it cannot depict)
雷电 -> 裂而未合 (split-and-not-rejoined — the condition for thunder-lightning's unity is the fissure that precedes and survives it)
噬磕 -> 噬嗑 (RETAIN: the verdict requires the name to persist as that which its own conditions cannot dissolve)
先王 -> 未生者 (the not-yet-born — the condition for "former kings" having acted is a futurity that underwrites the claim of pastness)
明罚 -> 罚之晦 (the obscurity within punishment — the condition for penalty-made-clear is the darkness penalty cannot expel from itself)
赤法 -> 法之隐纹 (the hidden grain of law — the condition for law-made-exact is the inexactitude law carries as its operative tissue)
以 -> 以 (RETAIN: structural particle required by syntactic preservation)

independent.recovered_law: TEXT B inverts the hexagram structure (trigrams and binary code are bitwise complements of TEXT A), reversing the directional relationships: upper/lower trigrams swap and invert, 亨 (success/penetration) becomes 阻 (obstruction), and the active clarifying authority ('先王以明罚赤法') becomes a passive, hidden, unborn agency ('未生者以罚之晦法之隐纹').
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural inversion: obstruction replaces penetration, active authority becomes passive/hidden agency, and directional relationships are reversed — the recovered claim specifies the hexagram-level mechanics while the declared claim articulates the philosophical consequences of the same transformation.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion of TEXT B maintains the inverted/negated relational structure throughout, with hidden law and unborn agents replacing bright punishment and former kings.
